import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem finite_closed_connected_union_perfect_decomposition {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    (A : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < n →
    (∀ k < n, IsClosed (A k)) →
    (∀ k < n, IsConnected (A k)) →
    (∀ k, 0 < k → k < n →
      (A k ∩ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j).Nonempty) →
    (∃ x y : X, x ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k ∧ y ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k ∧ x ≠ y) →
    ∃ V D : Set X, V.Countable ∧ Perfect D ∧ D.Nonempty ∧
      (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) = V ∪ D := by
  intro hn hclosed hconnected hover hxy
  have hconn :
      ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
        (∀ k < m, IsConnected (A k)) →
        (∀ k, 0 < k → k < m →
          (A k ∩ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j).Nonempty) →
        IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range m, A k) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        omega
    | succ m ih =>
        intro hm hc ho
        by_cases hzero : m = 0
        · subst m
          simpa using hc 0 (by simp)
        · have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
          have hprev :=
            ih hmpos
              (fun k hk => hc k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))
              (fun k hk1 hkm => ho k hk1 (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hkm))
          have hinter :
              (A m ∩ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range m, A j).Nonempty :=
            ho m hmpos (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
          have hrev :
              ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range m, A k) ∩ A m).Nonempty :=
            hinter.mono (by
              intro z hz
              exact ⟨hz.2, hz.1⟩)
          have hu :
              IsConnected ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range m, A k) ∪ A m) :=
            hprev.union hrev (hc m (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
          convert hu using 1
          ext z
          simp only [
            Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff,
            Set.mem_union
          ]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨i, hi, hzi⟩
            by_cases e : i = m
            · right
              simpa [e] using hzi
            · left
              exact ⟨i, by omega, hzi⟩
          · rintro (⟨i, hi, hzi⟩ | hzi)
            · exact ⟨i, by omega, hzi⟩
            · exact ⟨m, by omega, hzi⟩
  
  have hUconn := hconn n hn hconnected hover
  
  have hUclosed : IsClosed (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) :=
    (Finset.finite_toSet (Finset.range n)).isClosed_biUnion
      (fun k hk => hclosed k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
  
  have hUnontriv : (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k).Nontrivial := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩ := hxy
    exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩
  
  refine
    ⟨∅, ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k, Set.countable_empty, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      ⟨hUclosed,
        hUconn.isPreconnected.preperfect_of_nontrivial hUnontriv⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩ := hxy
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · simp
